title: Senior Engineering Manager- NKP
description:
**About the Team**

The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi-cloud environment.

NKP offers Container Attached Storage using Kubernetes pods to run AOS distributed storage fabric (Cloud Native AOS), enabling seamless integration with cloud native stateful workloads. The platform offers scale out, resilient and tiered storage. Supports storage features such as dynamic provisioning, thin provisioning, data efficiency, and application-centric snapshots. Cloud Native AOS can be used in both hyperconverged and disaggregated storage environments in a hybrid cloud environment. The stateful application Pods use the Nutanix CSI driver to consume storage entities that the AOS Pods present as Persistent Volumes. Much Like an on-premise HCI setup, Cloud Native AOS too provides all core Nutanix data management and copy data management functionalities.

**The Role**  
We are seeking a **Senior Engineering Manager** who is a “builder” at heart—someone who can architect complex storage software and, more importantly, architect the careers of the engineers who write it.

In this role, you will lead a team of talented junior and mid-level engineers. You will serve as the technical anchor and mentor, guiding the team through the challenges of containerizing our services while ensuring our storage control path remains the gold standard for performance and reliability.

You will design secure-by-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.

**Key Responsibilities**.

* Cloud-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads
* Architect, design and develop storage software for a computing+storage platform, Storage for AI - for cloud native environment.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Improve data path performance, scale-out and resiliency of our distributed control plane.
* Work closely with other development teams, testers, documentation writers and product management to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.
* Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: 12-18 years of software engineering experience and 2+ years of team management, with a proven track record of building large-scale distributed systems, cloud native platforms, or cloud infrastructure.
* **Storage Fundamentals**: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability. Understanding of the storage access protocols and features viz. SCSI/iSCSI/NFS/CIFS/S3/Cloud. Familiarity with x86 architecture, virtualization and/or storage management.
* **Kubernetes Expertise**: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Container Storage Interface (CSI), CNI, SCCs, MCS preferred
* **Systems Engineering:** Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), file systems, database back-ends, distributed storage systems and cloud based storage technologies. Experience with Hadoop, MapReduce, Cassandra, Zookeeper and other large-scale distributed systems preferred

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

**Work Arrangement**  
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. This role is based out of **Pune,** where employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of **3 days per week** to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. * Structured outputs: function or tool calling, JSON schema, Pydantic validation.

Expect the split to be roughly half hands\-on engineering and half oversight. The hands\-on half is the difficult half: retrieval architecture, agent orchestration, extraction accuracy, performance and cost. The oversight half is where you multiply — three to five engineers with one to two years of experience become independent owners of their workstreams within six months because of how you review, mentor and set standards.

**What will you do**
--------------------

* Own technical delivery of AI workstreams across concurrent client engagements: scope, design, sequencing, quality and honest estimates.
* Run the pre\-implementation design gate: review engineers' design notes, apply the tiered checklist, maintain the decisions register, and approve or send back before code is written.
* Set and enforce engineering standards for LLM systems — evaluation suites as release gates, prompt and model versioning, cost and latency budgets, guardrails and injection defenses, human approval gates, evidence and audit trails.
* Personally build the hardest components: retrieval and re\-ranking architecture, tool\-calling and agent orchestration on Temporal, document extraction pipelines, on\-premises and offline deployments.
* Review code at scale, including code produced with AI coding tools; catch invalidated model output, leaked secrets, missing tests and silent behavioral change before they merge.
* Mentor early\-career engineers with a deliberate plan: pair on design, grade their design notes, expand their ownership as they earn it.
* Represent engineering with clients: explain trade\-offs in plain language, push back on unsafe or unbounded asks, and turn vague requirements into a bounded phase\-one scope.
* Hold the security posture: secrets management via Vault and Key Vault, data residency, least\-privilege access, and client confidentiality on on\-premises work.
* Build reusable Centre of Excellence assets — evaluation harness, RAG reference implementation, guardrail library, extraction patterns — so that the method travels across clients even when the code cannot.
* Assess codebases and delivery risk candidly and communicate upward early, including when the news is unwelcome.

**What you must bring**

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
===============


The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.


Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap

**Requirements and Preferred Experience**
=========================================

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**


The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**


This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**


We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**


Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.
